title: Exercise: Tank Level with Hysteresis and Alarm
oneLiner: Run a fill pump between 20 % and 80 % with hysteresis, and raise a high level alarm with a deadband, so neither chatters around a single threshold.
keyTakeaway: Two thresholds and no assignment in between: the output keeps its last value inside the band, which is what stops it chattering.
explanation:
A fill pump keeps a tank between a low and a high level, and an alarm warns when the level gets too high. With one threshold the pump would start and stop constantly as the level ripples; two thresholds with a gap between them (hysteresis) make it run in long, calm cycles. The alarm gets the same treatment, a deadband, so it doesn't flicker.

Try it in the simulator with the simulated tank switched on to watch the pump cycle.
